channel.title: Monitoring | System Design
channel.description: In-depth system design tutorials — from zero to millions of users. Written for engineers who want to understand how large-scale systems actually work.

item.title: Design a Metrics Monitoring and Alerting System
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Ten million metrics, one year of retention, and a write load that never stops. Why a general-purpose database is the wrong answer, how Gorilla gets 16 bytes down to 1.37, and the cardinality bomb that kills more monitoring systems than any other cause — with an interactive calculator.
